response.sql:
WITH account_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        AVG(amount) as avg_amount,
        COUNT(*) as trans_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
),
global_avg AS (
    SELECT CAST(SUM(trans_count) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) as avg_trans_per_account
    FROM account_stats
)
SELECT 
    account_id,
    avg_amount,
    trans_count,
    trans_count / avg_trans_per_account as ratio
FROM account_stats, global_avg
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Average transaction amount across its credits and withdrawals" includes all transaction types in trans (PRIJEM, VYDAJ, VYBER). The phrase describes the computation (average of amounts) rather than filtering to documented credit/withdrawal types, since the request says "For every account in `trans`" without explicit exclusion.

alternatives.interpretation: "Credits and withdrawals" explicitly refers only to PRIJEM and VYDAJ transaction types, excluding VYBER (whose direction is undocumented). Include only accounts that have at least one credit or withdrawal transaction.
alternatives.sql:
WITH account_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        account_id,
        AVG(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN amount END) as avg_amount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN 1 END) as trans_count
    FROM trans
    GROUP BY account_id
    HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN 1 END) > 0
),
global_avg AS (
    SELECT CAST(SUM(trans_count) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) as avg_trans_per_account
    FROM account_stats
)
SELECT 
    account_id,
    avg_amount,
    trans_count,
    trans_count / avg_trans_per_account as ratio
FROM account_stats, global_avg
ORDER BY ratio DESC
LIMIT 10;
